title: Is there an app that turns a YouTube video or PDF into a short course?
metaTitle: An app that turns a YouTube video or PDF into a course
lede: Yes. Iro's Custom Paths turn a YouTube link, a PDF or any web page into a short course of three to seven lessons. Here's what it reads, how long the courses are, and what it costs.
keyTakeaways: Iro's Custom Paths turn a YouTube link, a PDF up to 10MB, a web page, a TikTok or Reddit link, or up to 4 screenshots into a short course.
You pick the depth (3, 5 or 7 lessons) and your starting level.
For YouTube it reads the video's captions, so the course is built on what was actually said.
Custom Paths are part of Iro Pro and unlimited; Instagram links are not supported, so use a screenshot instead.
description: Yes: Iro's Custom Paths turn a YouTube video, PDF or web page into a short course of 3 to 7 lessons, on iPhone and the web. What it reads and what it costs.
keywords: app that turns YouTube video into a course

toc.label: What you can turn into a course

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.html:
Yes. Iro's Custom Paths turn a YouTube video or a PDF into a short course you can study in the app, on iPhone and the web. Paste the link or upload the file, pick how deep you want to go (3, 5 or 7 lessons) and your starting level, and Iro builds the path.

For a YouTube video it reads the caption track, so the course is grounded in what the speaker actually said, not just the title.

sections.heading: What you can turn into a course
sections.html:
• A YouTube link: built from the video's captions.
  • A PDF: up to 10MB, like lecture notes, a report or a manual.
  • Any web page: an article, a guide or documentation.
  • A TikTok link: Iro transcribes the audio.
  • A Reddit link: it reads the post and the top comments.
  • Screenshots: up to 4 at a time.
  • A topic you type: when you don't have a source at all.

Instagram links can't be read. Share the post as a screenshot instead. Sources are used for that request only and are never stored.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.html:
1. In the Iro app or on the web, start a new Custom Path.
  2. Paste a link, upload a PDF, add screenshots or type a topic.
  3. Choose the depth: quick (3 lessons), standard (5) or deep (7).
  4. Choose your starting level, from new to this through advanced.
  5. Study the lessons one at a time, about five minutes each.

sections.heading: Getting a good course
sections.html:
The course can only be as good as the source. A long video with clear captions or a well-structured PDF gives the best result. For a short clip, pick the quick depth; for a long lecture or a dense report, go deep.

If you want to learn AI itself rather than a topic of your own, you don't need a Custom Path: Iro's 34 built-in paths cover tools like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and they're free to start.

sections.heading: What it costs
sections.html: Custom Paths are part of Iro Pro, which is $49.99 a year or $9.99 a month, with a 7-day trial, and Pro makes them unlimited. The 34 built-in AI paths are open without Pro, paced at a full lesson a day.

faq.q: Is there an app that turns a YouTube video or PDF into a short course I can study?
faq.a: Yes. Iro's Custom Paths, on iPhone and the web, turn a YouTube link, a PDF up to 10MB, a web page, a TikTok or Reddit link, or up to 4 screenshots into a short course of 3, 5 or 7 lessons at the level you choose. For YouTube it reads the captions. Custom Paths are part of Iro Pro and unlimited.

faq.q: Can Iro turn an Instagram post into a course?
faq.a: Not from a link: Instagram links can't be read. Share the post as a screenshot instead, and Iro builds the course from the image.

faq.q: Does Iro keep my PDF or video?
faq.a: No. Sources are used for that request only and are never stored.
